notes: v3 recipe on the same architecture (warm start from balanced_v2 best): the two biggest knobs are imgsz 1024->1536 and amp fp16, which restores the VRAM headroom that amp:false was spending.
epochs 20->120 with patience 25: round-2 runs stopped while val metrics were still improving; 4.2 minutes for 20 epochs leaves ample budget.
lr0 lowered to 3e-4 because this is a warm optimizer restart, not a fresh fit.
mosaic 0.15->0.35 and close_mosaic 5->15: dense small-symbol pages benefit from longer mosaic exposure; scale 0.2->0.4 and translate 0.05->0.1 widen position/size coverage.
hsv_v 0.1->0.25 simulates scan brightness drift on datasheet pages; hue/saturation stay off and rotation/flip remain off because schematic text and topology are orientation- and mirror-sensitive.
Rare-class coverage still comes from the balanced_v2 context crops; no dataset change in this config.
If OOM at imgsz 1536 batch 4 on the 8 GB card, rerun with --batch 2 or --imgsz 1280 via CLI overrides.
Expect the largest gains on small resistors/capacitors inside 3-5k pixel datasheet pages; verify with scripts/error_breakdown.py after evaluation.
